answer: Walnut River Gate Each agent must anchor its identity to a unique physical walnut tree via a cryptographically signed environmental reading taken at dawn. The reading captures soil moisture, ambient light, and microseismic data from the tree’s root zone. Only one registration is valid per tree; attempts to register multiple agents under the same tree fail. The attacker must physically plant and maintain a new walnut sapling—costing ~$75 in seed, labor, and 6 months of growth—per fake agent. This cost exceeds any gain from Sybil influence, making each clone strictly negative-EV.
